Nina (AE): Customer asks for a compact evidence packet for the POC: admin console events, API key rotation, emergency access, and proof exported logs are immutable for 12 months. Need in 48h.

Omar (SE): We can produce a small export (JSONL), manifest.sha256, PGP-signed manifest, and Splunk HEC + syslog-TLS runbook. Hosted retention = 90d, so export->customer S3 with object-lock COMPLIANCE + customer KMS is the recommended approach.

Ruth (InfoSec): Include these event types explicitly: admin.role.grant, api_key.rotate, emergency.access.grant, iam.assume_role. Redact PII by default and add a redaction appendix showing before/after. We'll sign the manifest and include PGP fingerprint in the attestation.

Mike (CustSec): Vendor team wants operator+job_id recorded for chain-of-custody, plus wording comparing COMPLIANCE vs GOVERNANCE modes. Splunk preferred.

Omar (SE): Sample audit lines we'll include (redacted where applicable):
{"ts":"2026-09-02T09:12:10Z","actor":"operator@redwood.com","action":"export.start","job_id":"job-a1b2","range":"2026-08-25..2026-09-02"}
{"ts":"2026-09-02T09:13:05Z","actor":"REDACTED_USER","action":"api_key.rotate","target":"svc-payments","result":"success"}
{"ts":"2026-09-02T09:14:20Z","actor":"REDACTED_USER","action":"admin.role.grant","target":"team-ops"}
{"ts":"2026-09-02T09:15:00Z","actor":"operator@redwood.com","action":"export.complete","job_id":"job-a1b2","artifact":"bundle-20260902.zip"}

Omar (SE): Splunk HEC runbook snippet to include:
curl -s https://splunk.customer.com:8088/services/collector -H 'Authorization: Splunk <HEC_TOKEN>' -d '{"event":{"ts":"2026-09-02T09:13:05Z","actor":"admin@cust.com","action":"api_key.rotate"}}'

Ruth (InfoSec): Immutability/chain-of-custody we provide: daily bundles -> push to customer S3 with object-lock COMPLIANCE; manifest.sha256 with per-file hashes; PGP-signed manifest (manifest.sha256.sig); attestation PDF stating scope, date-range, fields redacted, and PGP fingerprint. We'll include verification steps: sha256sum -c manifest.sha256 and gpg --verify manifest.sha256.sig manifest.sha256.

ExportBot: export job started (1825555555) - collecting events range 2026-08-25..2026-09-02 ETA ~40m

Nina (AE): Perfect. I'll tell the customer we'll deliver bundle + signed manifest + runbook in 48h and offer a quick walkthrough.

ExportBot: final bundle uploaded (1825555555/final-bundle-2026-09-02.zip) - files: audit.jsonl (1.4MB), manifest.sha256, manifest.sha256.sig, README_redaction.md, attestation.pdf - https://artifacts.internal/redwood/1825555555/final-bundle-2026-09-02.zip

Mike (CustSec): Received. We'll run the verification steps and revert with any follow-ups. Thanks for including operator/job_id in the export events.

Nina (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup: closing the loop with customer now.
